theory_variant: Lean 4 core dependent type theory with inductive types and proof-irrelevant Prop; used for the conditional policy calculus and controlled finite process models, not as a native HoTT-path proof system.
dependency_policy: The proof source imports only Lean core. The exact source file and the Lean executable are hash-pinned in each captured source manifest; no Mathlib package or project-local library is imported.
source_policy: No sorry, admit, axiom declarations, unsafe definitions, implemented_by, extern, opaque proof placeholders, native_decide, or kernel-skipping options in the delivery source. Each listed theorem is followed by #print axioms in the checked source.
